The backend checkout was correctly locked to charge exactly £1.00, but because of how the factory logistics engine calculates baseline delivery costs, the frontend button and UI still incorrectly displayed the price as £643 (adding minimum freight and UK delivery costs onto a £0 item). Refresh the page at and you'll see the test product now correctly says £1.00 everywhere, including the final pay button!

From DoStuff — ADHD Micro Break Accountabil.... Standard browser popup windows (window.open) don't have operating system permission to stay on top of other applications, which is why clicking another window sent it behind your open app. What is fixed: True Always-On-Top Floating (Picture-in-Picture): When clicking [⚡ Launch Widget], it now launches via Chrome's native Document Picture-in-Picture API. This gives the widget OS-level Always-on-Top privileges so it stays floating in the corner even when you click away, browse other tabs, or use other software. Never Blank: Injected full Tailwind CSS and fallback styling directly into the PiP window so it renders immediately with the active timer capsule and reset screen. If You Run Orb and DoStuff Simultaneously: Because Chrome allows only 1 PiP window at a time, you can also launch the native Desktop App (installed on your machine with npm start or the desktop shortcut), which uses Windows native Always-on-Top (screen-saver level) with zero browser conflicts. From DoStuff — ADHD Micro Break Accountabil.... Yes, absolutely. Full screen takeover will happen regardless of how you are running DoStuff: 1. In the Desktop App (Electron). The break window is configured with breakWindow.setFullScreen(true) and setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver', 1). The moment the countdown reaches 00:00, it launches across your entire monitor with a clean white frosted backdrop, placing the micro-break card in the center and locking out background distractions until you click [✅ Done]. 2. In Multi-Widget Window Mode (window.open). When the timer expires, the popout window automatically expands (moveTo(0,0), resizeTo(screen.availWidth, screen.availHeight)) and requests full screen, displaying the complete white frosted reset overlay. 3. In the Web App or Mobile APK (index.html). The #breakOverlay is set to fixed inset-0 z-[99999]. It takes over the entire display viewport with a clean white frosted lightbox (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) and triggers the browser's full screen API. You will never miss a break—it takes over cleanly without flickering or black backgrounds.
